title: Low quality
text: Low quality. Thinner than expected, also has shown signs of wear and little fuzzies in just a week (without washing). Also pretty small. Picture looked like it would be higher quality.

product_metadata.title: LOMAO Knitted Throw Blanket with Tassels Bubble Textured Lightweight Throws for Couch Cover Home Decor (Teal, 60x80)
features: MATERIAL - Blanket size 60x80’’, Made of 100% high quality acrylic which is warmth than fleece ,strong anti-sunlight and excellent light fastness, very soft and breathable at the same time.

SMALL Bubble DESIGN- This knitted blanket with a pretty Small bubble weave and fringe design,it not only looks modern, classical but also offers you an amazing touch feeling. A perfect gift for your family and friends.

MULTIFUNCTIONAL BLANKET- With its 3.9'' long fringe design , this thin lightweight blanket can be use as a shawl and scarf in outdoor. Indoor, it can be use as a sofa ,nap blanket also a beautiful home decoration.

ALL SEASON USE- This premium throw blanket is warm and cozy, making it the ideal choice for all season use. Its lightweight makes it easy to store and carry with, perfect for traveling and backpacking.
EASY CARE- Machine wash with cold water separately on gentle/delicate cycle. Tumble dry on low heat. Avoid direct heat, No bleach.It is better to wash before first time use.
